name: @pipeworx/mcp-emoji

tools.name: emoji_lookup
tools.description: Look up an emoji by :shortcode: (e.g. ":fire:" or "fire") to get the character + keywords, OR pass an emoji character to get its shortcode/name. Keyless, offline.

input.description: A :shortcode:, a bare shortcode, or an emoji character.

tools.name: search_emoji
tools.description: Search emoji by keyword/name (e.g. "party", "money", "animal") and return matching emoji with shortcodes. Keyless, offline.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-emoji forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the emoji pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
